title: Code and data for "Energy security can accelerate domestic synthetic fuel adoption and CO2 abatement"
description: Code, processed data and source data that reproduce every figure and table of the article "Energy security can accelerate domestic synthetic fuel adoption and CO2 abatement". Code is released under the MIT License and data under CC BY 4.0. The hourly solar and wind capacity factors (3.0 GB) are attached to the GitHub release. See README.md for installation, a demo and instructions.
